Description
The 10 oz gold bar Pamp Suisse Lady Fortuna is one of the popular series produced by the world’s leading precious metal refiner
PAMP Suisse
. PAMP’s iconic Lady Fortuna design is recognized worldwide as a guarantee of PAMP quality and authenticity.
These
10 oz gold bar
pamp Suisse lady Fortuna w assay has become a popular choice for investors looking to diversify their precious metal portfolio due to its liquidity, high purity, exceptional quality, and the fact that they are eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
PAMP(Produits Artistiques Meatux Precieux) is a prominent state-of-the-art refinery that was founded in Ticino, Switzerland in 1977. The Swiss Federal Bureau for the Control of Precious Metals accredits independent sworn assayers to certify the purity of PAMP Suisse gold bars.
The PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Gold Bar includes 10 troy ounces of .9999 pure gold and is packaged in a sealed serialized, tamper-evident casing with an assay card for optimal security and instant authenticity.
Design of 10 oz Gold Bar Pamp Suisse Lady Fortuna w Assay
The obverse of the 10 oz gold bar Pamp Suisse Lady Fortuna features the depiction of the Lady Fortuna, the Roman Goddess of fortune, and the personification of luck. The Roman Goddess of fortune, Lady Fortuna is depicted in left-profile relief. She is accompanied by many of the common design elements that her figure features within popular art. Her figure wears a veil that winds down to the bottom of the bar’s design field, with a
cornucopia
on her head. The horn of plenty blows a shower of gold coins into Fortuna’s waiting hands.
The reverse of the 10 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar Lady Fortuna features the depiction of the PAMP logo at the top of the design area, with the remaining markings arranged vertically down the bar’s face. The PAMP Logo includes the letters PAMP inscribed inside a small four circle and the word Suisse engraved below. The other labels on the 10 oz PAMP Suisse Fortuna Gold Bar are the weight, purity, metal composition, and serial number. The following are the serial numbers for this series: The serial numbers in this sequence are identified using a one-letter, six-number code.
